checks.label: foreground service starts without printing its auth token
separate CLI invocation preserves local storage
goto public text replaces the document
unsupported HTML fails without replacing the current document
close-all removes only the service's named sessions
private connection file is removed on shutdown

limitations: A package-owned foreground service and separate CLI processes are exercised, not a Chromium/Firefox engine.
Only public JSON/plain-text documents load; HTML rejection is a known missing feature, not compatibility success.
No website JavaScript, full cross-document history, artifact rendering, automatic service launch or playground UI is exercised.
Only synthetic local in-memory storage is mutated; authentication tokens, page bodies and process output are not retained.
